body: Server-side matchmaker: connecting players placed in DM warm-up (SCENE_DUST_COMPOUND) instantly; CTF queue fires when 2+ players share MODE_CTF → all moved to SCENE_STADIUM via PacketSceneChange. sendWelcome extended to 13 bytes (sceneID + gameMode); sendSceneChange extended to 15 bytes. Client: FIND CTF as default join action, PacketSceneChange handler in net_tick, animated SEARCHING FOR CTF HUD banner, live CTF score header on match. Commit b37b883.
title: Lobby: CTF matchmaker + DM warm-up
